info: Edmund Optics #65-254 TOMBO lenslet model. One representative on-axis lenslet plus the bench-plan aperture stop, baffle-mask opening, FLIR cover glass, and sensor-side gap. Lengths in mm; wavelengths in um. Ideal catalog surfaces; coating losses, scatter, decenter, tilt, and array-neighbour cross-talk are not included.

tombo_model_notes.lens: Edmund Optics stock #65-254, uncoated plano-convex, N-LASF9
tombo_model_notes.lens_orientation: Curved face toward object; plano face toward sensor
tombo_model_notes.psf_sampling_grid: 256x256 over the 0.2208 mm crop; 4x finer than a camera pixel
tombo_model_notes.cover_glass_model: Nominal n=1.5, treated as nearly nondispersive; exact glass type not specified in the bench plan
tombo_model_notes.single_lenslet_scope: One centered channel only; the 4x4 array layout, lateral field-dependent PSFs, mask-wall scatter, and inter-unit ghost/crosstalk are not modeled
tombo_model_notes.throughput_note: PSFs in the current TOMBO code are normalized to unit sum. Uncoated Fresnel loss is therefore not present in the normalized PSF; the bench plan compensates primarily with exposure time.
